CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 7

2. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 1

3. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

4. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 65

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

8. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 13

9. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 2

10. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

11. Solve for x: x + 4 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 11
   D. 15

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 18

14. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

15. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x < 5

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
